answer: The willow holds work receipts rather than names, so the comet of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, forfeited on duplicate submission. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the ridge of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short.
